bridge42worlds — science retold for people, in five languages.
If this letter reached you by mistake, simply don't reply: we keep no mailing list, and there will be no second letter.

en.inv_1: You are invited to the supervisory board of bridge42worlds — a project that turns fresh research papers into articles anyone can read, every day, in five languages.
en.inv_2: The board decides where the project goes: priorities, hard choices, principles. Sessions are weekly and every decision is public. You can send a proposal by replying to this letter — no key, no account, no visit to the site required.
en.rule_1: the project is non-commercial: we sell no access and show no ads;
en.rule_2: if money ever appears, it goes into the work;
en.rule_3: any labour must be paid honestly, transparently and fairly.
